name: Target Species
description: Primary species targeted by the product.

name: Food Form
description: Physical form of food, treat, or chemical product.

name: Primary Protein / Flavor
description: Main flavor or animal protein source (e.g. Chicken, Beef, Salmon, Lamb, Peanut Butter).

name: Package Weight / Volume
description: Standardized package size (e.g. 4 lb, 30 lb, 50 lb, 12.5 oz, 1 gal).

name: Organic / Natural Status
description: Indicates if the product is certified organic or all-natural.

name: Protein Percentage
description: Crude protein percentage for livestock feeds (e.g. 16%, 20%).

name: Joule Rating
description: Output energy rating in Joules for electric fence energizers.

name: BTU Rating
description: Heating output capacity in BTUs for heaters and stoves.

name: Fuel Type
description: Fuel or power source for heaters, splitters, and power equipment.

name: Towing Capacity
description: Maximum towing capacity rating in pounds.
